Good day to you.

rows.en: What is it? Munch munch.

Oh, ah, AAAH!
I-I was supposed to hang out with
Yuuto today! Yeah, that's right...

Huh?

...Hello,

I don't think??

...I hear you've gotten awfully close
with that man lately?

rows.en:

rows.en:
Go home, keep warm,
and get a good night's sleep.

I'll make you an appointment,
so make sure you come.

rows.en:

...?

hard time fitting in...

rows.speaker: Canaria

Ozma and the others aren't bad people

how they feel.

rows.en:

rows.en:

rows.speaker: Luis

good pilot. He was a lot younger than me, too,
so I treated him like my own kid brother.

rows.en: He always gave me the happiest smile...

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en: He was such a great pilot... So why......!

rows.en:

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:

rows.speaker: Luis

rows.speaker: Luis

I wandered in a whirlpool of loneliness

That was you, my soulmate!

and gives off a flash too bright to look at.
Honestly, right now I'm not sure I can take it.

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
To become a man worthy of you,
I need to polish my mind and body
just a little more.

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
So I'm setting out on a journey. I don't know
when I'll be back. I thought long and hard
about this... Please forgive me.

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
It's too late now, and it'll only sound like
an excuse, but I'll tell you anyway...

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
I'm sure that radiance of yours

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:

of them as you can.

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:

future for the Frontier... no, for the
whole galaxy.

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:

rows.speaker: Luis

rows.speaker: Luis

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en: Last of all, I promise you this.

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:

I'll come back to you for sure! I swear it!

but I don't really have anything to do here...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Huh? It's Saotome-kun.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Hm?
Some sleazy-looking guy is talking to him...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Don't tell me...
He's hitting on Saotome-kun, thinking he's a girl?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Whoa, Saotome-kun's getting mad. Real mad.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The guy realized Saotome-kun's a guy
and took off.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Saotome-kun's a hit even outside school, huh.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Okay, I'd better head home before
a grumpy Saotome-kun spots me...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Class is over, so all that's left is to go home.
Man, I'm starving...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Hey, Alto, wanna stop by Nyan-Nyan or something?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Nah, I've got groceries I already bought,
so I'll pass today.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh? Alto, you cook for yourself?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
I live alone. Of course I do.
I can't afford to waste money.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
I can handle cooking, cleaning and laundry
well enough.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
That's amazing, Alto.
Seriously, you'd make a great wife!

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Hey. What did you just say?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I meant "house-husband." Sorry...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(But I still think
"wife" suits him better...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Class is over, so all that's left is to go home.
Gosh, I'm starving...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Hey, Saotome-kun, wanna stop by Nyan-Nyan
or something?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh? Saotome-kun, you cook for yourself?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
That's amazing, Saotome-kun.
Seriously, you'd make a great wife!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Oh, this is one of Sheryl's songs...
Seriously, not a day goes by
without hearing a Sheryl song.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Come to think of it, Alto, you used to be
in showbiz, right? Have you ever met Sheryl?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Of course not.
Don't ask such stupid questions.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Hmm, so you've never met her.
I wonder what kind of girl Sheryl is?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Showbiz people are bound to be short-tempered,
selfish jerks anyway.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(True, Alto used to be in showbiz himself,
and he's short-tempered and loves to grandstand...
That explains it.)

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Hey, you're thinking something rude,
aren't you?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: N-No, not at all...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Alto's sharp at the weirdest times.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Oh, this is one of Sheryl's songs...
Seriously, not a day goes by
without hearing a Sheryl song.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Come to think of it, Saotome-kun, you used to be
in showbiz, right? Have you ever met Sheryl?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Hmm, so you've never met her.
I wonder what kind of girl Sheryl is?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(True, Saotome-kun used to be in showbiz himself,
and he's short-tempered and loves to grandstand...
That explains it.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Geez, Saotome-kun's sharp at the weirdest times.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Uh-oh, Alto looks like he's in a bad mood...)

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Damn it! That Michael...!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Did you get into another fight with Michel, Alto?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
I'm sick and tired of his sloppy,
half-assed way of doing things!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
But from where I'm standing, you and Michel
seem to get along pretty well.
They say the more you fight, the closer you are, right?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Me, get along with that guy? No way.
Can you even imagine it?
Michael and me, being all buddy-buddy?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Nice work, Alto.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Heh.
It's all thanks to your cover, Michel.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
What are you talking about?
It's because you're here, Alto,
that I can fly with peace of mind.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: I'm counting on you from here on too, partner!

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
And I'm counting on you, partner!
No... my precious partner.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Alto......

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Michel......

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I managed to imagine it... but ew, that's creepy.)

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
A-ny-way!
There's absolutely no way I'd ever
get along with that guy!!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(They don't look like they get along badly to me...
Is that just my imagination?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Uh-oh, Saotome-kun looks like he's in a bad mood...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Did you get into another fight with Michel-kun,
Saotome-kun?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
But from where I'm standing, you and Michel-kun
seem to get along pretty well.
They say the more you fight, the closer you are, right?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I managed to imagine it... but ew, that's creepy.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(They don't look like they get along badly to me...
Is that just my imagination?)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Haha, don't get so mad, Princess Alto.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Grr, Michael, you bastard!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Alto and Michel got into another fight, huh...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Those two are always fighting,
but how long have they known each other?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Alto, got a sec?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: What is it, \p?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
You and Michel get along great, Alto.
How long have you two known each other?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Get along?
Well, now I know your eyes are just for show...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Let's see...
I met Michael right before we graduated junior high.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Somebody from the Pilot Course wrecked one of
Nanase's paintings, so I tried to make them apologize.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
And that's when I met Michael...
Come to think of it, I never did get him
to apologize for that.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Hey, Michael!
About that time back then...!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh? Oh, wait...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I went and dug up an old feud...
Sorry, Michel!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Saotome-kun and Michel-kun got into another fight,
huh...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Those two are always fighting,
but how long have they known each other?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Saotome-kun, got a sec?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
You and Michel-kun get along great, Saotome-kun.
How long have you two known each other?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I went and dug up an old feud...
Sorry, Michel-kun!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Okay, time to give it my all again today...
Hm, Alto and Luca? ...Something feels off...)

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: You'd never understand, Alto-senpai! Never!

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Like you'd understand how I feel!

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Nope! The stubborn one here is definitely you,
Alto-senpai!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Now, now, calm down, both of you...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Oh, \p...
Hey, hear me out for a sec...

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Alto-senpai is being so mean! He said, "Lucky you,
Luca. You're younger than me and skipped a grade,
and your grades are still perfect..." and stuff...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Hey, it's the truth!

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
There are things even I can't do, no matter how hard
I try! My flying is nowhere near as good as
yours or Michel-senpai's, Alto-senpai...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Give it another year and you'll fly just like us!
You're only getting started!

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: There's no guarantee of that anywhere!

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Then I'll guarantee it!

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Huh...!?
Senpai...
Thank you so much!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Well, it all worked out okay... I guess...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Okay, time to do my best again today...
Hm, Saotome-kun and Luca-kun? ...Something feels off...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Come on, now, calm down, both of you...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Well, it all worked out okay... I guess...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Okay, what's my next class...
Huh? Alto and Ranka...?)

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Alto-kun, please!

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
What are you thinking?
There's no way I could do that!

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Sure you can, Alto-kun!
I just know the customers would love it, too!

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Quit messing around!
What would I even get out of doing that...
Just go do it yourself!

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Wha... You don't have to put it like that...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Come on, Alto, there's no need to get that mad...

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Oh, \p-kun!
You tell him too, \p-kun!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh? Tell him what?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Nyan-Nyan's holding a Uniform Beauty Contest soon,
and I just know Alto-kun would win if he entered!
So...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Don't "So..." me!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Those two get along great, I bet...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Okay, what's my next class...
Huh? Saotome-kun and Ranka-chan...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Come on, Saotome-kun, there's no need to get that mad...

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Oh, \p-chan!
You tell him too, \p-chan!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Those two get along great, I bet...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Well, that's it for today's classes...
Huh, it's Alto and Michel... Another fight?)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: I won't budge on this one. It's definitely you!

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Wha-!?
No way! It's obviously you!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
No, no,
my name's not nearly as well known as yours!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: What on earth's going on? Why all the shouting...?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Oh, \p.
Well, see, we were arguing over which of us
will get more chocolate this Valentine's...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Obviously it's gonna be this womanizer, right!?
I'm not even all that...

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Hmm... You sure about that...?
I know all about the presents from guys
that keep piling up in your locker...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Wha-!? Th-those don't count!
Besides, I toss that stuff the second I get it!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Oh-ho, so you admit you get them from guys,
our gorgeous former female-role actor,
"Prin-cess Al-to."

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Miii-chaaa-el!!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Both of them just take it for granted they'll get
tons of chocolate... And they admit it about
each other. That's impressive...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Well, that's it for today's classes...
Huh, it's Saotome-kun and Michel-kun... Another fight?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: What on earth's going on? Why all the shouting...?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Oh, \p-chan.
Well, see, we were arguing over which of us
will get more chocolate this Valentine's...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Both of them just take it for granted they'll get
tons of chocolate... They really do acknowledge
each other.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The guy who came as Ranka's bodyguard...
With that blank face, I can never tell
what he's thinking...)

rows.speaker: Brera
rows.en: Hey.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(He just stands at the back of the room
with a blank face all through class,
so everyone's kind of on edge...)

rows.speaker: Brera
rows.en: Hey. You there.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh!
M-Me?

rows.speaker: Brera
rows.en: Yes. I hear you're close to Ranka.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Oh, yes, we get along really well.

rows.speaker: Brera
rows.en:
I see...
Then there's no problem.

rows.speaker: Brera
rows.en:
(Um... Did he stop me
just to ask me that?)
rows.notes: Name plate says Brera, but the line is the male player's inner monologue (brackets, boku); translated as the player's thought.

rows.speaker: Brera
rows.en: However...!!

rows.speaker: Brera
rows.en:
If you ever hurt Ranka,
I will eliminate you that very instant!

rows.speaker: Brera
rows.en: Remember that, if nothing else.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Wh-What on earth was that just now...
Is that part of a bodyguard's job too?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Hmm... Come to think of it, I feel like
something like this happened before...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The guy who came as Ranka-chan's bodyguard...
With that blank face, I can never tell
what he's thinking...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh!
M-Me?

rows.speaker: Brera
rows.en:
(Um... Did he stop me
just to ask me that?)
rows.notes: Name plate says Brera, but the line is the female player's inner monologue (brackets, watashi); translated as the player's thought.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Wh-What on earth was that just now...
Is that part of a bodyguard's job too?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Summer vacation, huh...
What should I do this summer...)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Hello, \p-kun.
It's hot again today, isn't it?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Sure is... *sigh*

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: You seem kind of low on energy.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Ahaha... The summer heat's getting to me...
You look full of energy, Senpai.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
You've got to cut loose in summer at least,
you know?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: ...Okaaay.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Senpai looks so cool, like the heat
doesn't even touch her.)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Hello, \p-chan.
It's hot again today, isn't it?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Senpai sure is full of energy.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(In a month, I'll get to meet the Galactic Fairy
herself. Seriously, it's like a dream...)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
What's got you so excited,
\p-kun?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Claire-senpai!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Are you going to Sheryl's concert, Senpai?

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: I wanted to, but I couldn't get a ticket.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Are you going?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
...Actually, I'm going to be doing
an EX-Gear stunt there.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: ...Wow, that's amazing!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I'm going to give it everything I've got.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Good luck. I'll be cheering for you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I can't wait for the concert!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(In a month, I'll get to meet the Galactic Fairy
herself. Seriously, it's like a dream...)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
What's got you so excited,
\p-chan?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Are you going to Sheryl's concert, Senpai?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I can't wait for the concert!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Looks like everyone's finally settling down...
I guess finding a destination really makes
a difference.)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Oh, \p-kun.
Have you been well?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yes, more or less.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
A new planet's been found,
and you're awfully calm about it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I'm excited too, you know!
It's just that I don't know what I should do.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
I know.
It's all still way too vague to make sense of.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Well, let's figure it out together.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Looks like everyone's finally settling down...
I wonder if finding a destination really makes
that much of a difference.)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
\p-chan,
have you been well?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yes, pretty well.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I'm excited too, you know!
It's just that I don't know what I should do.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(...It's the middle of the night,
but I'm getting hungry...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
For a midnight snack, cup ramen's the way to go.
...Huh, who's that over there...?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Claire-senpai, what are you doing...?

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Y-You must have the wrong person.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
There's no way I'd mistake you.
Are you restocking on late-night snacks too, Senpai?

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Th-That's not it, okay? I did not buy any cake!

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: I'm telling you, I didn't buy any!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (So she bought cake.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
For a midnight snack, cup ramen's the way to go~
...Huh, who's that over there...?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Claire-senpai, what are you doing?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (So she bought cake.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I went a bit farther out while I was shopping,
but the damage has spread all the way out here...)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
\p-kun...
What are you doing in a place like this?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I could ask you the same, Senpai.
It's dangerous around here.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: I wanted to see the damage with my own eyes.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
This is our city, after all...
We have to protect it...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Right, let's do our best!

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Mm, it's good to stay positive.
See you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Our city, huh... I don't know what I can do,
but I've got to do whatever I can...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

rows.en:

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Our city, huh... I don't know what I can do,
but I've got to do whatever I can...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Tests are finally over...)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: You look totally wiped out.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Claire-senpai...
Tests are finally over, so I'm all deflated.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: How did you do?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: So-so, I guess...

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: You have to study properly every day, you know.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I can't argue with that...

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Hehe... Don't look so down.
Just do better next time, okay?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: ...Oh, okay!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Claire-senpai is so kind.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Phew, tests are finally over...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
So-so?
...Kinda?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Ugh, I can't argue with that...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Maybe I'll splurge and eat out today.)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Oh, \p-kun.
Heading home?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yes. I was just thinking
I might splurge on a meal out.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Ooh, sounds nice...
So what are you planning to eat?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
A lavish yakiniku feast!
At the very least, I want a hamburger steak.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Meat, huh...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: You don't like it, Claire-senpai?

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: I don't dislike it... but I'm not especially fond of it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: O-Oh, really... But it's so good.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Don't worry about me.
Go eat whatever you like.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I'll shake it off and go for pasta, I guess.)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Oh, \p-chan.
Heading home?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh, you don't like it, Claire-senpai?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I'll shake it off and go for pasta, I guess.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Argh, I went to the bathroom and now I'm late...
The teacher's gonna chew me out if I'm tardy!)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Kyaa!

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Geez, watch where you're going...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I-I'm sorry...
Claire-senpai...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Are you hurt?

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
I'm fine, so don't make that face!
It's my fault too for not looking where I was going...

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Okay.
Class is about to start, so let's hurry.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (...Claire-senpai is so soft...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Argh, I went to the restroom and now I'm late...
The teacher's gonna scold me if I'm tardy!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (What should I have for lunch...)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Oh, \p-kun.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Mmph... Please stop calling me "rich boy,"
Michel-senpai.

rows.speaker: Michael
rows.en: Haha, don't pout like that, Luca.

rows.speaker: Michael
rows.en:
Oh, come to think of it,
I haven't introduced myself either.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Michael Blanc's the name.
Call me Michel, nice and friendly.
rows.notes: Mihaeru Buran -> 'Michael Blanc' (glossary); asks to be called Misheru -> 'Michel'. Name plate here already reads Michel.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Nice to meet you, Michel.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Luca-kun, what are you all doing
standing in the classroom doorway?
rows.notes: Nanase ('??? (woman)'); Ruka-kun-tachi = Luca-kun and the others.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
N-Nanase-san!
Uh, oh, yes... This person here
is \p-san, and, um...

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
We were just introducing ourselves
to each other, or, well, something like that...

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Oh, I see.
Then I'd better introduce myself too.

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
I'm Nanase Matsuura.
I'm in the Art Course, so I'm in a different
course from you all, but it's nice to meet you.
rows.notes: Geijutsu-ka (art course) is not in the glossary; 'Art Course' by analogy with Pilot Course / Performing Arts Course (geinou-ka). Not the same as geinou-ka.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Nice to meet you too, Nanase.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Hey, Alto, at least introduce yourself.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: ...Alto Saotome.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Alto-senpai, that's really not enough...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: ...Nice to meet you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Nice to meet you too, Alto.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: ...Yeah.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I was a little nervous about school life,
but I'm glad I made friends right away...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I've gotta keep this up and work hard
to make school life a blast!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Phew, made it just in time...
I almost ended up late for the entrance ceremony.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Starting today, I'm a student at Mihoshi Academy
High School, the Frontier fleet's top school for
specialists. I'd better stay on my toes.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: No, I'm the one who should be sor...
rows.notes: Cut off mid-apology as in the Japanese.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (What a pretty girl...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Y-yeah... I'm fine.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I can't exactly admit I was staring at her...
But why is she wearing
a boys' uniform?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh right, I haven't even introduced myself yet.
I'm \p.
Nice to meet you all!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I see... No wonder he doesn't look our age.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Nice to meet you, Michel-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Nice to meet you too, Saotome-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I was a little nervous about school life,
but I'm glad I made friends right away...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I've gotta keep this up and work hard
to make school life a blast!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Classes start for real today... I wonder what
our Practical and Basic Training teachers are like?
I hope they're nice...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Class names follow the schedule help (u5459/u5460: practical training, basic training).

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
I'm the one teaching you lot "Practical Training."
The name's Gary Murdoch.
rows.notes: jitsugi kunren -> 'Practical Training' (schedule help u5459); not in the glossary.

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
And I'll be teaching "Basic Training."
Hilda V. Bergen.
rows.notes: kiso kunren -> 'Basic Training' (schedule help u5460); not in the glossary.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
I'll drill you lousy eggs till you puke blood,
so you can at least hatch into chicks!
Look forward to it!
rows.notes: tamago yarou (egg bastards) / hiyokko (chicks): kept the egg-to-chick image.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Training till we puke blood...?)

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: Hey, Gary, don't scare the students so much.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: I'm just tellin' 'em the facts, aren't I?

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
That's exactly what scaring them means...
Honestly. Don't take what Gary said seriously.
He's just exaggerating.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Phew, that's a relief, then. I'm glad
Hilda-sensei seems kind, despite how
she lo...)
rows.notes: Cut off mid-word as in the Japanese (yokka...), interrupted by Hilda.

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
Because if you're puking blood in Gary's class,
people are going to die in mine...

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
Don't worry. Soon enough, the pain
will turn into pleasure...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I feel like she just said something terrifying...)

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: You're the one scarin' 'em worse...

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
...That concludes the class overview.
If there are no questions, that's all for today.
Dismissed!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Just hearing the overview was enough to tell
these classes are gonna be brutal...)

rows.speaker: ??? (man)
rows.en:
Hmm, Gary-sensei's puke-blood training...
And Hilda-sensei's, even tougher than that...

rows.speaker: ??? (man)
rows.en:
Ahh, I can't wait!
Just how intense is this training gonna be...?
Right? You think so too, don't you?

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
Oh, sorry, I haven't introduced myself yet!
I'm Yuuto Kagura! As friends chasing the
same dream, let's get along from here on!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Y-yeah... Nice to meet you too.

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
Alright, 100 laps around the field, to get
a head start on class!! See you later!
rows.notes: yoshuu mo kanete = also as advance preparation for class.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh? Oh, see ya...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Yuuto sure is a fired-up guy...)

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
I'm sorry. Yuuto's loved working out and training
ever since way back, and sometimes he ends up
causing trouble for the people around him...
rows.notes: Miyuki Shirakawa ('??? (woman)'). 'Ever since way back' (mukashi kara) is echoed by the player in c21215/c21244.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, I see.
Um, and you are...?

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en:
I'm Miyuki Shirakawa.
Nice to meet you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah, nice to meet you too.
"Ever since way back"... So you and Yuuto
go way back?

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en: Yes, we're childhood friends.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh, I see.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en: Mm-hmm, I see, I see~

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en:
He runs out of control like that sometimes,
but he's a good kid at heart, so please
be friends with him.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en: Roger that from me too~

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Wait, you've been joining in this whole time
like it's nothing, but... who are you?

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Hobby: tinkering with machines. Favorite food:
field rations. No real dislikes.
Three sizes, from the top...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Instead of all those little details,
could you just tell me your name?

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en: Oh yeah, I left out the most important part...

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en:
The name's Yui Hoshimura!
Nice. To. Meet. Ya!
rows.notes: yo-ro-shi-ku spelled out syllable by syllable.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: ...Nice to meet you too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (She's so hyper...)

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en: Geez, Yui, you never change.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Shirakawa, do you know Hoshimura too?

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en: We were in the same class in junior high.

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en: Yup yup, me 'n' Miyuki are best buds for real.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh, is that s......
rows.notes: Cut off (sou na...) by Kagura's scream.

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
GWAAAAAAAH!!
My leg's crampiiing!!

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
But I won't let something like this beat me!
I... I can still keep going...!

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en:
Alrighty! Then I'll give ya a quick mod
so your legs never cramp again~!

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
Stop it!
I can't do something like cheating!
I... I want to break my limits on my own...!

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en:
Then let's just mod your whole body
and blow past human limits~!!

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en: ...Um, I'm really sorry about all this.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: You don't have to apologize, Shirakawa...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I'm glad I made all kinds of friends, but...
this school sure has a lot of quirky people.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh? Oh, see you...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Kagura-kun sure is fired up...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, I see.
Um, and you are...?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah, nice to meet you too.
"Ever since way back"... So you and
Kagura-kun go way back?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Miyuki, do you know Yui too?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: You don't have to apologize, Miyuki...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Let's see, next up is Lectures...
Come to think of it, I wonder who our teacher
will be? I'm kind of looking forward to it.)
rows.notes: zagaku (classroom study) -> 'Lectures', matching the schedule help u5458 ('Attend lectures'); not in the glossary.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en: Um, excuse me...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yes?

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
I forgot my textbook...
Would you mind sharing yours with me?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Sure, of course.

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
Oh, I'm Yuu Akimizu!
Nice to meet you!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I'm \p.
Nice to meet you too.

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
I'm really sorry.
I lent my textbook to a friend and forgot
to get it back...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: That's rough. Don't be shy, go ahead and look.

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
Anyway, I wonder what kind of teacher
we'll get. Aren't you excited?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yeah, I was wondering about that too.

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en: Oh, looks like the teacher's here.

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
I am Pinon Colette-sensei, and I'll be
teaching your "Lectures" class.
rows.notes: Pinon calls herself Pinon Colette-sensei. Class name 'Lectures' as in c21247.

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
I'll explain things extremely gently so even
the likes of you can understand, so be grateful
and take my class!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Wait, um...
No matter how you look at it, she looks like
an elementary schooler, right?

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
Yes, she does...
But...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: But?

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en: That girl... is sooo cute...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh?!
O-oh, y-yeah, I guess...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I don't think whether she's cute or not
is the point right now...)

rows.speaker: ??? (man)
rows.en:
Pinon-kun, what are you doing
in someone else's class?

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en: Ack! Yamashiro!

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
My apologies for being late.
It seems someone hid my textbook...

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
I'm Itsuki Yamashiro, and I'll be in charge
of the "Lectures" class.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, I knew it.
I mean, Pinon-chan being a teacher
was kind of a stretch...

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en: No, it's no lie that Pinon-kun is a teacher.

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
She falls into the category of genius.
At her age, she already holds a teaching license.

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en: That's right, I'm amazing!

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
I intend to have her teach Special Lectures.
So the "teacher" part is, technically, true.
rows.notes: tokushu zagaku -> 'Special Lectures' (follows 'Lectures'); not in the glossary.

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
That's right, I'm a teacher!
You lot! Show some respect and call me
Pinon-sensei!

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
However, Pinon-kun...
You're supposed to be a teacher AND a student.
And I'm the one teaching this class.

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
Which means right now you're just a student...
Would you take a seat over there?
And take off the lab coat, too.

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
Grr!
You'll pay for this, Yamashiro!

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
Damn you, Yamashiro!
I knew I should've hidden it somewhere
harder to find...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Nice to meet you, Pinon-chan.

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en: Nice to meet you too, Pinon-chan!

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en: I told you to call me Pinon-sensei...!

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en: Now then, let's begin class.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Pinon-sensei and Yamashiro-sensei, huh...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It's not just the students...
Mihoshi's got plenty of quirky teachers too...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Let's see, next up is Lectures...
Come to think of it, I wonder who our teacher
will be? I'm kind of looking forward to it.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Sure, of course you can.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I'm \p.
Nice to meet you too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: That's rough. Don't be shy, go ahead and look.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yeah, I was wondering about that too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh?!
O-oh, y-yeah, I guess...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It's not just the students...
Mihoshi's got plenty of quirky teachers too...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Ugh, this is bad...
I was only trying to get to the library,
and now I'm lost inside my own school...)

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Oh? Do you need one of the third-years?
If you'd like, I can go get them for you.
rows.notes: Claire ('??? (woman)'). Neutral 'them' for the unspecified senior.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Well, you were standing around puzzling
in front of the third-year classrooms.
Wouldn't anyone assume that?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, no, that's not it.
I was actually trying to get to the library
and got lost...

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
The library's in the complete opposite direction...
How on earth did you end up here?

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Hehe, you're a funny one.
Oh well, I'll take you to the library myself.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Running into each other like this must be fate.
It's no trouble at all.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Thank you very much.
Um...

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
It's Claire. Claire Stanford.
Nice to meet you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I'm \p.
It's nice to meet you too.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Well then, shall we get going...?

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en: Waaah! Claire~!

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Klan, what's wrong?

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Michel...
That jerk Michel made fun of me agaaain~

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Aww, there, there.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (A-a kid...?)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Sorry, \p-kun...
Would you mind waiting a little
before I show you to the library?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Sure, no problem.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Hm! You're a first-year in the Pilot Course,
aren't you?

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
If you see Michel, give him a message! Tell him
Klan Klang said, "Next time we meet,
I'm gonna beat you to a pulp!!"

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Michel, what on earth did you do to this kid...?)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Sorry, Klan.
I have to take this one to the library.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: I see. Sorry for holding you up, then.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
...Oh, come to think of it,
I haven't asked your name yet.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I'm \p.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
All right, \p...
If you don't pass that on to Michel,
be ready for a punishment to match!

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Mm, as long as you understand.
See you.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Well then, let's get going too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
By the way, Claire-senpai...
Did Klan-senpai skip a grade or something?

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Klan and I are the same age.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Apparently, when she micronizes,
her body turns into a little kid's.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Here we are, this is the library.
Think you can make it here on your own
next time without getting lost?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I-I'll be fine!
Sorry for making you show me the way...

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Don't mention it. Feel free to rely on me
anytime. Hehe, see you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Claire-senpai's so caring and grown-up...
Klan-senpai, on the other hand, looks younger
than me no matter how you look at it...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Claire-senpai and Klan-senpai...
I'll probably be counting on them a lot,
so I'd better make sure we get along.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Ugh, this is bad...
I was only trying to get to the library,
and now I'm lost inside my own school...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I'm \p.
It's nice to meet you too.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Sorry, \p-chan...
Would you mind waiting a little
before I show you to the library?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Michel-kun, what on earth did you do
to this kid...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I'm \p.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Claire-senpai's so caring and grown-up...
Klan-senpai, on the other hand, looks younger
than me no matter how you look at it...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Claire-senpai and Klan-senpai...
I'll probably be counting on them a lot,
so I'd better make sure we get along.)
(All this shopping's made me hungry...)
rows.notes: Also used with variant 'single' and in a non-dialogue entry (speaker '-'); gender-neutral.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I know, I'll grab lunch at the Super
Dimension Restaurant, Nyan-Nyan.)
rows.notes: Choujikuu Hanten 'Nyan-Nyan': 'Super Dimension Restaurant' not in the glossary (Nyan-Nyan is). Shared male/female.

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: Welcome to Nyan-Nyan!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Wait, huh? Nanase?

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: Oh, if it isn't \p-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh right, Nanase, you work part-time
at Nyan-Nyan, don't you?

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
Yes, that's right.
This is the first time we've run into each other
while I'm at work here, isn't it...

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
Oops, I'd better cut the chatter,
or the manager will scold me.

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: What would you like to order?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Let's see... Then I'll have the Galaxy Ramen.
rows.notes: Ginga Raamen -> 'Galaxy Ramen'; menu item not in the glossary.

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
Certainly.
Please wait just a moment.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Haah, I can't wait for my Galaxy Ramen...)

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Here you are! One Fried Dragon Chicken
set meal, sorry for the wait!
rows.notes: Ranka ('??? (woman)') bringing the wrong order. okyakusama (customer) not rendered as sir/ma'am: shared by both player genders. 'Fried Dragon Chicken' not in the glossary.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh?
But I only ordered the Galaxy Ramen...

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
Ranka-san,
the Fried Dragon Chicken set goes to Table 3.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
...Ah!
I-I'm so sorry about that!

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
You'd better hurry and serve Table 3.
The manager's watching, too...

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: R-right! Thanks, Nana-chan!

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
Sorry, \p-kun.
Ranka-san can be a bit of a scatterbrain
sometimes...

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: I'm so sorry about earlier.
rows.notes: To the player as a customer (okyakusama).

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Nah, don't worry about it.

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
\p-kun says it's fine,
so don't worry, Ranka-san.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Huh?
Nana-chan, you know this customer?

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: Yes, we're classmates.
rows.notes: Kurasumeito as in the Japanese, though c21168 had Nanase in a different course.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Ohh, I see.
Then I'd better introduce myself too.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
I'm Ranka Lee.
I go to St. Maria Academy, so we're at different
schools, but it's nice to meet you!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Nice to meet you too, Ranka.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
St. Maria Academy... That's the famous
prestigious school for young ladies, right?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
My big bro kept nagging me,
"You're going to St. Maria for high school,
no matter what!"

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh, so you have an older brother, Ranka?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Yes. He's a kind, great big brother, but
he's a little too overprotective of me.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: I'm not a little kid anymore...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
That just shows how much he cares
about you, Ranka.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Of course I know that.
For my sake, he even quit being a pilot
because it's dangerous, and took a desk job.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: He really is a good brother, huh.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: He is, but...

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
I kinda wish he'd stop bragging about me

I'll keep the training rooms and such open
so you can train whenever you like.

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
Train on your own, study on your own...
Use them however you see fit!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Training on my own, huh... I'd like to take it
easy at least over summer break, though...)

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
How you spend your summer break
is up to you.

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
...But anyone who slacks off had better be ready
to cry the moment the new term starts!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (...I'm gonna work hard and train on my own!)

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: There's one last thing I want to say...

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
Enjoy your summer break to the fullest!!
That's all! Dismissed!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Summer break starts next week...
Like Hilda-sensei said, if I don't train on my own,
I'll probably go through hell once break is over...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(But it's summer break, after all, so I've gotta
have plenty of fun and enjoy it to the fullest!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Phew~ I know it's the last class of the school year,
but you're going way too hard on us,
Hilda-sensei...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (...I'm gonna work hard and train on my own!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Summer break starts next week...
Like Hilda-sensei said, if I don't train on my own,
I'll probably go through hell once break is over...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(But it's summer break, after all, so I've gotta
have plenty of fun and enjoy it to the fullest!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Okay, classes are over,
so I guess I'll head home soon.)

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Hey, \p.
What do you think you're doing, heading home?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh? Was there something, Gary-sensei?

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
You've completely forgotten, haven't you...
Your career plan survey is due today.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Ah!? Oh, right...!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I'm sorry... Gary-sensei.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Geez, I bet you lost the form too.
It's too much of a pain, so just tell me out loud.
rows.notes: koutou (the script writes it with the wrong kanji): answer orally.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
You're only a second-year, so it doesn't have
to be all that clear-cut a career path.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Let's see...
Join a military like the New U.N. Forces or S.M.S.
and take the path of a "soldier"...
rows.notes: gunjin rendered "soldier" throughout this scene, minkanjin "civilian".

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Or stay out of the military, aim for college,
and take the path of a "civilian"...
rows.notes: Shared with scd_fes_813 where Hilda says it; works for both.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: So, which'll it be?
rows.notes: Dotchika erabe? Gary asking the player to pick.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (That seems way too rough-and-ready, though...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Uh, well, I'd say...
rows.notes: Male only (both occurrences); female twin is c22298.

rows.speaker: choice
rows.en: I want the "soldier" path

rows.speaker: choice
rows.en: I want the "civilian" path

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
All right, the "soldier" path it is.
I'll fill in the form and hand it in for you,
so don't worry.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: And don't you forget to hand it in next time.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yes, sir... I'm sorry...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(A career plan, huh...
I wonder what's waiting for me in the future?)
rows.notes: x6, male in scd_com_510 and scd_fes_813.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
All right, the "civilian" path it is.
I'll fill in the form and hand it in for you,
so don't worry.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Okay, "soldier" works for you, right?
There, decided!
rows.notes: Gary decides for the player in this branch.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:

a soldier. So I'm putting down "soldier."
Got a problem with that?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: N-no, that's fine...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I was going to say "soldier" anyway,
so it's not really a problem, but...)

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Well, like I said, you're still only a second-year.
You've still got time to think about what
you want to do. Give it some real thought.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I'm sorry...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Uh, well, I'd say...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

I wonder what's waiting for me in the future?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
PLAYER/none
rows.en:

it was just right for shaking off the summer daze.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

so I'd better get my head in the game!)

rows.en:

What's got you all tensed up?
rows.notes: Katahiji haru: being stiff/tense; shared male/female.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Hey, Alto.
Starting tomorrow, we're getting underclassmen too,
so I figured I should act more like an upperclassman.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:

Who needs underclassmen anyway?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
What are you talking about, Alto?
We're finally getting underclassmen.
You should take them under your wing.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: I couldn't care less.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:

you'll have underclassmen adoring you, like
"Big Sis Alto, you're so dreamy~!"
rows.notes: Alto onee-sama: kinship word translated ("Big Sis Alto"), schoolgirl-crush joke at Alto, who played female roles.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I could actually see that happening with Alto...)

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Michael...! You bastard!
rows.notes: Alto calls him Mihaeru: "Michael" per glossary.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Geez, Princess Alto really
can't take a joke, can she?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Joke or not, don't call me princess!

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Honestly, those two never change, do they?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Haha, yeah.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

through the same back-and-forth for almost
a year now...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Looking back on it like this,
this year really felt like it flew by.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:

it was a really full year.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yeah, maybe...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

and you guys around...
Seriously, thanks for this past year...

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Haha, it is a little embarrassing.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: How can you say that without even blushing...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Wh-what?!
Here I go to the trouble of thanking you guys...

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Haha, don't get so down about it.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Anyway, we're counting on you from here on too.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Please keep looking out for us.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: ......I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Alto, curt: "yoroshiku tanomu" given its subject.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah!
And I'm counting on you guys too!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I hope I can spend another fun year with Alto
and the others, now that I'm a second-year.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Still, today's joint training
didn't feel all that tough...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I guess this past year has toughened me up
in body and mind too.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
PLAYER/none
rows.en:

rows.en: Well, I...

rows.en:

rows.en: Nothing at all. Come on, let's go.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yeah, let's...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Thing is, there was a little mix-up, and we're
short on entrants for three events.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Sorry, but I need you to enter one of
the three events I'm about to name.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: Actually, you don't get a say in this.
rows.notes: Kyohiken wa nai: "you have no right to refuse".

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Y-yes, understood...

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
The first event is the "100m Dash."
If you're confident in your "Stamina" and
"Speed," give this one a shot.
rows.notes: Stat names (tairyoku/sokudo) rendered as pilot parameters "Stamina"/"Speed"; shared with scd_fes_510, both genders.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
The second event is the "Tug-of-War."
If you're confident in your "Melee" and
"Defense," give this one a shot.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
The third event is the "Ball Toss."
If you're confident in your "Shooting" and
"Focus," give this one a shot.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Out of these three events,
which one do you want to enter?

rows.speaker: choice
rows.en: 100m Dash

rows.speaker: choice
rows.en: Tug-of-War

rows.speaker: choice
rows.en: Ball Toss

rows.speaker: Gary

I'll take care of the entry,

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: Alto

Who'd have thought I'd be running in the same

rows.speaker: Luis

rows.speaker: Kagura

rows.speaker: Akimizu
