Besides, it's to thank you for everything, too...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Wow, so you can be thoughtful like that, huh?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Tch, forget it! I'm not giving you anything back!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I was just kidding~

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Is Saotome-kun just a stickler for returning
favors... or...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I feel bad for Saotome-kun, but it's too
embarrassing after all. I can't give him
the chocolate...)
rows.notes: The Japanese line lacks its opening bracket (source typo: only the closing one is there). Opening parenthesis added since it is clearly the player's inner monologue, as in the matching lines for the other boys.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Hmm, I wanted to give Michel-kun the chocolate,
but the timing never worked out...)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Whoa, what are you doing in a place like this,
\p?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh? Oh, um, well...
I was hoping to give you some chocolate,
Michel-kun...

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Well, what do you know.
I was bummed, thinking I wouldn't get any
from you, but you had some ready for me.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Sorry it's so late...
Here, Michel-kun.
This Valentine's chocolate is for you.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Thanks, \p.
I'll be sure to enjoy it later.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
And I'll pay you back properly on White Day,
so look forward to it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It was a bit late, but I'm glad I managed
to give Michel-kun the chocolate. I wonder
what he'll give me back on White Day?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I wanted to give Luca-kun the chocolate,
but the timing never worked out...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Luca-kun! I've been looking for you all over~

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
You were?
Is something wrong?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Here, Luca-kun. It's late, but
this is your Valentine's chocolate.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Oh, thank you very much.
I'll be sure to enjoy it later.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Oh, and I'll be sure to return the favor on
White Day, so look forward to it!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It was a bit late, but I'm glad I managed
to give Luca-kun the chocolate. I wonder
what he'll give me back on White Day?)

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: Oh, \p-kun!

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
Here. I thought I'd give this to you,
\p-kun...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh? This is for me?

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: You always help me out, so I thought maybe...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Wow, thank you!

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
I gave it a Chinese-style twist, so I can't
promise how it'll taste, though.
rows.notes: Chuuka-fuu: Nanase works at the Chinese restaurant Nyan-Nyan.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Ch-Chinese-style...

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: Well then, I'll be heading home.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(If she put her own twist on it, that means
it's homemade chocolate, right...?)

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
H-heeey!
\p-kun!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh, Ranka?
Weren't you working today?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
...Yeah, but I got a little time off,
and there was something I wanted to give you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Something for me?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Geez~ Today's Valentine's Day, isn't it?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Here! Take it!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh? Oh, th-thanks!
I hadn't gotten any from anyone,
so I'm really happy!!

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
So mine's the only one, huh?
That makes me kinda happy.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Well, I'd better get back!
That chocolate's homemade, by the way!!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Homemade chocolate from Ranka...
I'd better savor every bite.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh, Sheryl?

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
Why the gloomy face?
I know, you didn't get any chocolate!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Sh-shut up...

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Oh, did I hit the nail on the head...? Sorry...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Nah, it's fine...

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
Oh, it can't be helped. Then I, Sheryl,
will give you some chocolate!
rows.notes: Kono Sheryl ga: Sheryl referring to herself by name.

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
Don't get the wrong idea. I'm only doing it
out of pity for you!

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
Don't mention it. But you owe me big for this,
so don't you forget it!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It doesn't look great, but it's tasty...
Wait, is this homemade?)

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: H-hey! \p!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, Klan-senpai!
What brings you to Mihoshi?
Do you need something?

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: ...I have something to give you!

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
T-today's Valentine's Day, after all!
So I, in my great kindness, shall give
you some chocolate!
rows.notes: Kokoro yasashii watashi ga: Klan's grand self-description kept.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: Here! Take it!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh? Oh, th-thank you so much!
I hadn't gotten any from anyone,
so I'm really happy!

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Listen, it's just obligation chocolate! Obligation!
Don't get any weird ideas.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Mm, good.
I-it's chocolate I made myself, so savor it well!

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: S-see you!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Homemade chocolate from Klan-senpai...
I'd better savor every bite.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The Practical Test is coming up soon,
so maybe I'll get in some training
on my own today.)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Oh, if it isn't \p.
You showed up at just the right time.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Yes. The thing is, the Pilot Course got a job
request asking us to perform EX-Gear
acrobatics at a concert.
rows.notes: Luca, answering the player's 'Need something from me?'. Koukuuka = Pilot Course (glossary).

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
So we'd like you to be in that concert too...
That's no problem, right?
rows.notes: Michel asks the player to perform.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
What?!
Are you sure it's okay for someone like me
to be in it?

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
With your skills, \p-san,
it won't be a problem at all.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
We're giving you our seal of approval.
So go in with some confidence.
rows.notes: Michel. Taikoban wo osu = vouch for, guarantee.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Michel... Luca...
All right, I'd love to perform too!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Great, so that settles the performers
for the 'Sheryl' concert.
No problem there, right, Luca?
rows.notes: The Japanese sets Sheryl in quotes; the player has not caught on yet. Kept the quotes.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Right.
Now all that's left is to decide on the
acrobatics program for the 'Sheryl' concert!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
...Huh? What?
...What do you mean, the 'Sheryl' concert?

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
What?! \p-san...
Don't tell me you don't know
about the famous Sheryl?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
If the Sheryl you're talking about, Luca,
is 'Sheryl Nome,'
then of course I know her...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Wait, you really mean the Galactic Fairy...?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Yeah. We're going to be in the concert
of the Galactic Fairy, 'Sheryl Nome.'

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!!!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Y-you're kidding me, right?! Luca?!

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
No, of course it's true,
\p-san.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
We'll be flying at Sheryl's concert.
If we messed up, it'd be a disaster...

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
That's true.
If we messed up...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Come on, don't you two suddenly
put that kind of pressure on me...

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Haha, I'm just kidding.
Like I said, you'll do just fine.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Besides, Sheryl's concert or not,
what we're doing is no different from usual.
Let's just take it easy.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Sigh... There's no way I can
shrug it off like you, Michel, but...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah! I'll perform at
Sheryl's concert too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: ...Besides, I'd like to meet Sheryl.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Heh, I'm counting on you, \p.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I'm going to be performing at Sheryl Nome's
concert... I still can't believe it...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I'll actually get to meet the Galactic Fairy...
I'd better at least be ready
to get an autograph...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
What?!
Are you sure it's okay for someone like me
to be in it?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Michel-kun... Luca-kun...
All right, I'd love to perform too!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
If the Sheryl you're talking about, Luca-kun,
is 'Sheryl Nome,'
then of course I know her...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Y-you're kidding me, right?! Luca-kun?!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Come on, don't you two suddenly
put that kind of pressure on me...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Sigh... There's no way I can
shrug it off like you, Michel-kun, but...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah! I'll perform at
Sheryl's concert too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I'm going to be performing at Sheryl Nome's
concert... I still can't believe it...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I'll actually get to meet the Galactic Fairy...
I'd better at least be ready
to get an autograph...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(There was a rumor that a transfer student
was coming to our class, so I was looking
forward to seeing who it'd be, but...)

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
I'm Ranka Lee, and I've transferred into
the Performing Arts Course.
It's nice to meet you all!
rows.notes: x4 (also scd_fes_201). Geinou course = Performing Arts Course, a provisional glossary entry.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I never imagined the transfer student
would be Ranka...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
That was a surprise.
I never thought you'd transfer to Mihoshi,
Ranka.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Hehe, I kept it a secret from everyone.
If you were surprised, then it worked
perfectly!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: But why did you transfer to Mihoshi, anyway?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Well, the thing is...
I got scouted by a talent agency and started
working, so I couldn't stay at my old school.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
So I took Mihoshi's transfer exam.
I was so nervous~ It's famous for being
tough, with practical exams and everything.
rows.notes: Ranka; x4 (also scd_fes_201). Reflowed within 3 lines.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
And you passed, so as of today
you're a Mihoshi student, huh?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Yep, that's right.
So look out for me at school too from now on,
\p-kun.
rows.notes: Ranka; also scd_fes_201. Korekara wa gakkou demo yoroshiku.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Okay, I'm going to go say hi to Alto-kun
and the others too. See you, \p-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Ranka transferring here was a surprise,
but now we get to enjoy school life together.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It'd be nice if Ranka and I could get
even closer than before......)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Wait, there's a commotion in the schoolyard.
What's going on?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Huh?! That's Sheryl, isn't it...?
Why is the Galactic Fairy at Mihoshi?!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It's been a few days since Sheryl's surprise
visit, and Mihoshi should've calmed down
by now, but...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(How did it come to this?
How......)

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
I've transferred into the Pilot Course.
I'm Sheryl Nome.
rows.notes: x4 (also scd_fes_201). Pairotto koosu = Pilot Course (glossary alias).

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The Galactic Fairy, Sheryl Nome,
has transferred to Mihoshi!!)

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
I transferred here because I wanted
to get a little taste of high school life.

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Nice to meet you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Not just Ranka, but even THE Sheryl
transferring here...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (This really isn't a dream... is it...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I never imagined the transfer student
would be Ranka-chan...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
That was a surprise.
I never thought you'd transfer to Mihoshi,
Ranka-chan.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
And you passed, so as of today
you're a Mihoshi student, right?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Yep, that's right.
So look out for me at school too from now on,
\p-chan.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Okay, I'm going to go say hi to Alto-kun
and the others too. See you, \p-chan.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Ranka-chan transferring here was a surprise,
but now we get to enjoy school life together.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It'd be nice if Ranka-chan and I could get
even closer than before......)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Wait, there's a commotion in the schoolyard.
What's going on?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Huh?! That's Sheryl, isn't it...?
Why is the Galactic Fairy at Mihoshi?!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(How did it come to this?
How......)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The Galactic Fairy, Sheryl Nome,
has transferred to Mihoshi!!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Not just Ranka-chan, but even THE Sheryl
transferring here...)
rows.notes: The female player says bare 'Sheryl' here (no -san), as in the Japanese.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (This really isn't a dream... is it...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I heard our class was running a cafe
as its event this year, but...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Culture Fest class attraction (dashimono). 'cafe' without accent (Shift-JIS).

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Welcome home, Master!
rows.notes: Ranka, maid-cafe greeting (goshujin-sama); the female version c23147 uses 'Milady'.

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Welcome to the 'Galactic Fairy' Cafe!
rows.notes: Sheryl; shared male/female. The cafe is named after her title.

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Oh, wait... It's just \p.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(So it's a cafe, all right...
a maid cafe...)

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
What are you spacing out for?!
We're almost out of time before we open.
Hurry up and get ready!
rows.notes: Sheryl to the player; shared male/female.

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en:
Welcome hoooome~~!!
Will it be tea? Will it be swee~ts?
Or perhaps... my-sel......
rows.notes: Hoshimura; shared male/female. The classic 'bath, dinner, or me (a-ta-shi)?' gag, cut off after 'a-ta'; cut 'myself' at the matching point.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
...Hoshimura, you're the one who remodeled
the classroom, right?

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en:
Yep, that's right!
A job like this is a cinch for yours truly!
rows.notes: Hoshimura; shared. 'Yours truly' for her old-fashioned voice.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Like last year, can you really call this
just a remodel? I can see the ocean and
an artificial island outside...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Oh well... Better not dig too deep!)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
I'm counting on you today,
\p-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh?! Claire-senpai!
If you're wearing a maid outfit, then...

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Yes, I came to lend a hand today.
Klan came along to help too.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
That said, it looks like Klan came
for another reason rather than to help...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Another reason?

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: That. Over there.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Welcome home, young master.
rows.notes: Michel in a butler outfit (obocchama); female version c23154 'my lady'.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: A b-butler outfit...?!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Miyuki got them ready to bring in
a wider range of customers.
rows.notes: Michel; shared. Kyakusou wo fuyasu = broaden the clientele.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Though apparently she couldn't rent many
butler outfits, so there aren't a lot of them.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Hmph! Even you clean up nice
in the right clothes, Michel!
rows.notes: Klan; shared. Mago nimo ishou (even a packhorse driver looks fine in good clothes): a backhanded compliment.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
But you in that butler outfit...
I-it doesn't NOT suit you!!
rows.notes: Klan; shared. Niattenaku mo nai = the grudging double negative kept.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
And your maid outfit...
Well, it's not bad, I guess.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: R-really...?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(They could just compliment each other
like normal people...)

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Those two really
can't be honest, can they?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Tell me about it...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Oh, you're in a butler outfit too, Luca.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Yes, for some reason there was one in my size,
so I figured I'd better wear it...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I see.
Huh? Come to think of it, where's Alto?

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Alto-senpai is over there.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, a butler outfit.
And here I was sure...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
'I thought Alto would be in a maid outfit'...
Is that what you were about to say,
\p?
rows.notes: Alto. The quote is in his own words (third person), as in the Japanese.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: N-no way, of course not...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Hmph! Good, then.

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: You look pretty sharp in that, Alto.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Uh-huh, you look so cool, Alto-kun!

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
You think? I'd say your maid outfits
suit you pretty well too...
rows.notes: Alto to Sheryl and Ranka; shared.

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Oh... Why, you think so...?

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Aw, you're making me blush, Alto-kun...

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
But Alto, between Ranka-chan and me in our
maid outfits... I look better, don't I?

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
Ranka-chan's just sort of...
lacking in sex appeal, isn't she?
rows.notes: Sheryl; shared. Iroke ga nai, kept at full strength.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
I-I don't think having a great figure
is everything!

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Pushing your chest out for no reason
is kind of vulgar... or, how do I put it......

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
V-vulgar...
You've got some nerve, Ranka-chan.

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Alto! Hurry up and say who looks better!

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Huh?! W-well, let's see...
Hey, \p...
rows.notes: Alto, looking to the player for help; shared.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I'd better go get ready for opening...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Hey, don't run away!

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Alto!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Alto sure has it rough...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Right, I'd better hurry and get ready too,
or we won't be open in time.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Sheryl Nome's pull is really something.
The response is so huge we're swamped.)

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
\p-kun,
please take the order at table 5.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Sure, got it.
By the way, Nanase, you've been working
nonstop this whole time. Aren't you tired?

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
I'm fine!
Just getting to see Ranka-san in a maid
outfit is enough for me...

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: Well, I'll go put the order through!

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
\p-kun,
please take this to table 3.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Roger.
Are you okay too, Akimizu? You've been
working nonstop this whole time...

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
No problem at all!
Just getting to see Claire-senpai in a maid
outfit is enough for me...

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en: I'll go take the order at table 5!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(How should I put it...
those two run on the same fuel...)

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en:
You keep worrying about everyone else,
but what about you, \p-kun?
Aren't you tired?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I'm fine.
What about you, Shirakawa? Are you okay?

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en:
Yes. I may not look it,
but I have plenty of stamina.
rows.notes: Shirakawa; shared. Kore demo = despite appearances.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
In that case, the one who doesn't
seem okay is...

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en: Pinon-chan, I suppose...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
She's been working so hard with that
little body of hers...
Hey, Pinon-chan!

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
Huff, huff... What is it... \p...
I'm incredibly busy right now......

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: You look tired. Take a little break.

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
Wh-what are you talking about?!
Huff, huff... I'm not tired at all!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(She's definitely overdoing it.
She won't take a break no matter what I say,
so in that case...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Pinon-chan...
If you say you won't take a break...

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en: If I say that, then what?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Claire-senpaaai!

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: What is it, \p-kun?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Pinon-chan says she wants to sleep over
at your place tonight, Claire-senpai!
In her maid outfit, of course...
rows.notes: Shared. Claire-senpai no ie = 'your place, Claire-senpai' since the player is talking to her.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
...I-is that true, Pinon-chan?!
Of course it's fine by me!
Hehe, the two of us in the same bed...

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en: Eek!!

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en: I-I'm taking my break now!!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: She ran off like she was fleeing...
rows.notes: Shared; the player's line without a plate. Subject 'she' = Pinon.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Hehe, Pinon-chan's such a hard worker,
she'd never take a break unless we
pulled something like this.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Sorry for making you play
such a weird part...

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Sigh~ What a shame, though.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Pinon-chan coming for a sleepover in her
maid outfit... Just imagining it makes me...
rows.notes: Claire; shared. Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(C-Claire-senpai?
Don't tell me she was serious just now...?!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (W-well, no point worrying about it...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Okay, the Culture Fest is almost over!
I've gotta keep at it too!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Phew~ It's finally over~
We had even more customers than at last
year's Culture Fest. I'm totally beat.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Good work to you too, Yuuto.

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
So the Culture Fest is already over...
It was so busy and so much work, but now
that it's ending, it feels kind of lonely...

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
What's with the gloomy faces?
There's always next year, so just
enjoy it all over again then.
rows.notes: Sheryl to Kagura and the player (the player has just agreed with Kagura); shared.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
That's right, \p-kun!
We just have to make next year's
Culture Fest even more fun than this one!
rows.notes: Ranka. Subject 'we' restored: the class makes it more fun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Sheryl... Ranka......

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
You're right...
Yeah... Let's definitely do that!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(There's another Culture Fest next year.
I hope I can enjoy it with these friends
again.)

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Welcome home, Milady!

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Oh, wait... It's just \p-chan.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(So it's a cafe, all right...
a maid cafe...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
...Yui, you're the one who remodeled
the classroom, right?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Like last year, can you really call this
just a remodel? I can see the ocean and
an artificial island outside...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Oh well... Better not dig too deep!)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
I'm counting on you today,
\p-chan.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Welcome home, my lady.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Tell me about it...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Oh, you're in a butler outfit too, Luca-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I see.
Huh? Come to think of it, where's Saotome-kun?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, a butler outfit.
And here I was sure...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
'I thought Saotome-kun would be in a maid
outfit'... Is that what you were about to say,
\p?
rows.notes: Alto quoting the female player's own form of address.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: N-no way, of course not...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I'd better go get ready for opening...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Saotome-kun sure has it rough...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Right, I'd better hurry and get ready too,
or we won't be open in time.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Sheryl Nome's pull is really something.
The response is so huge we're swamped.)

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
\p-san,
please take the order at table 5.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Sure, got it.
By the way, Nanase, you've been working
nonstop this whole time. Aren't you tired?

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
\p-chan,
please take this to table 3.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Roger.
Are you okay too, Yuu? You've been
working nonstop this whole time...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(How should I put it...
those two run on the same fuel...)

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en:
You keep worrying about everyone else,
but what about you, \p-san?
Aren't you tired?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I'm fine.
What about you, Miyuki? Are you okay?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
She's been working so hard with that
little body of hers...
Hey, Pinon-chan!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: You look tired. Why not take a little break?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(She's definitely overdoing it.
She won't take a break no matter what I say,
so in that case...)

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: What is it, \p-chan?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(C-Claire-senpai?
Don't tell me she was serious just now...?!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (W-well, no point worrying about it...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Okay, the Culture Fest is almost over!
I've gotta keep at it too!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Phew~ It's finally over~
We had even more customers than at last
year's Culture Fest. I'm totally beat.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Good work to you too, Kagura-kun.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
That's right, \p-chan!
We just have to make next year's
Culture Fest even more fun than this one!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Sheryl-san... Ranka-chan......

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
You're right...
Yeah... Let's definitely do that!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(There's another Culture Fest next year.
I hope I can enjoy it with these friends
again.)

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
\p, got a minute...?
There's something I want to give you.

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
It's my return gift for Valentine's.
I'd like you to accept it...
rows.notes: Kagura. Okaeshi = White Day return gift.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Thank you, Kagura-kun.
...Wait, what is this?

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
It's a book of aerial photos of ancient
heritage sites on Earth. They're so vast
and beautiful, aren't they?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Wow... Thank you so much, Kagura-kun.

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
I'm glad you like it.
I guess choosing it carefully paid off.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(He really put thought into a present
just for me... That makes me so happy.)
rows.notes: x3: the female player after the gifts from Kagura, Yamashiro and Luca, all male, so 'he' works for each.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It's White Day today.
I wonder if Gary-sensei remembered?)

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Hey, \p.
What are you doing in a place like this?

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: Mm. Once class is over, head on home.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Um, Sensei, aren't you forgetting something?

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
Hm? What is it?
If it's money, I don't remember
borrowing any...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Ugh, never mind! Excuse me!

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: Ah, \p, hold on a sec.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yes?!

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: Here, this is for you. Hang on to it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Sensei... this is...

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: Well, call it... thanks for the other day...
rows.notes: x3: Gary (White Day), Luis (White Day), and in Michel's White Day scene the row has no name plate (filed as the player) though it reads like Michel's line, probably a missing plate in the script. The wording works for all three.

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en: Well then, get home safe!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(A leather accessory, huh...
Gary-sensei's got better taste than I thought.)

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
Oh, Fresh Girl!
I was just looking for you.
rows.notes: Luis's nickname for the female player (fresh gaaru; 'Fresh Boy' for the male player elsewhere). Not in the glossary; kept as an English nickname.

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
My precious partner...
no, you could even call it my soul.
I'm giving this mic to you as a present!

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
Take good care of it.
This guy's a little on the delicate side.
rows.notes: Luis, speaking of the mic as 'koitsu'.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Shirakawa,
since it's White Day, here...
my return gift.

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en:
Oh, um... You didn't have to
get me a return gift...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
You gave me chocolate, so I couldn't
just let it go! Go on, open it up.

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en: Oh, this is...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah, when I think of your hobbies,
Shirakawa, it's tea, so I went with
a teacup.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: What do you think?

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en: Are you sure I can really have this?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Of course!
I bought it for you, Shirakawa.

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en:
...Thank you... \p-kun.
I'll treasure it for the rest of my life...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I'm glad Shirakawa seemed happy with it.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, Hilda-sensei!
This is my return gift for Valentine's Day!

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: Hm? Ah, it's you?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yes, I thought it might do as thanks
for the other day...

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: This is... a cake...?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yes, it's from a popular shop
in the Shibuya Area!

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
Are you an idiot?
Don't hand me a lump of sugar and fat
like this!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Ah... that's... I'm sorry...

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: Honestly, what were you thinking...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, then I'll, um, come back another time.
I'm sorry...

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
No, wait.
I'll gladly accept the gratitude behind it,
so I'll take that too. Cake now and then is fine.
rows.notes: Hilda. Tama ni wa keeki mo ii darou.

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
But don't you repeat the same mistake
next time!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Hilda-sensei really is kind underneath...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Here, Hoshimura.
It's White Day, so this is my return gift...

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en:
Ooh, now that you mention it, today's White Day!
Well then, I'll accept it without
further ado, I will!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I hope you like it...

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en: Wh-why, could this be...
rows.notes: x2: Hoshimura (wrench) and Pinon (ribbon) on seeing the gift; works for both.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah, you love tinkering with machines,
right, Hoshimura? So I figured maybe
a top-grade wrench, but...
rows.notes: Trails off: Hoshimura answers '\p...' (outside this slice) and the player panics.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh, you don't want it?
I'm really sorr...
rows.notes: Cut off as in the Japanese (gome...).

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en:
No, no, I'm tickled pink! You truly mean it?!
Givin' me something this fine!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Of course.
I bought it for you, Hoshimura.

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en: Th-thank you kindly... \p.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Yeah, Hoshimura seemed happy too.
I'm really glad I gave her a return gift.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It's White Day today, but I wonder
if Yamashiro-sensei remembered?)

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
\p, good timing.
There's something I want to give you.

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
This is a return gift for Valentine's.
Take it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Thank you, Yamashiro-sensei.
...Wait, what is this?

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
An assortment of homemade candy and cookies.
As a White Day return gift, nothing
could be more fitting.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Wow... Thank you so much, Yamashiro-sensei.

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en: I'm glad to see you like it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, Akimizu.
This is my return gift for Valentine's Day...

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en: Huh? Oh, th-thank you!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I'm not sure if you'll like it, but...

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
Wow, it's so cute~!!
Thank you~!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I remembered you collect stuffed animals
and cute stuff... It's a plushie of
a creature called a 'Gyararashi'...
rows.notes: Gyararashi (in quotes in the Japanese) is not in the glossary; romanized. Akimizu says it goes with Mylene of Fire Bomber.

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
Uh-huh, it's really cute!
It's the one that's always with Mylene-san
from Fire Bomber, right?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, is that so?
You really know your stuff, Akimizu.

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
Yes, I've actually wanted one for ages...
so I'm really happy!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Glad to hear it~

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
Even if it was by chance, you picked
the perfect thing! Let's keep getting
along from now on, okay?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I can't believe Akimizu was that happy...
I'm glad I gave it to her!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Claire-senpai,
it's White Day, so here's my return gift.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
You went to the trouble of bringing it?
Thank you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Here, please go ahead and open it.
rows.notes: x2: the player to Claire and to Klan (both senpai).

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Oh my, this is...!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yes, I heard aromatherapy was your hobby,
Senpai, so I got you an aroma candle.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en: Are you sure I can really have this?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Of course.
I bought it for you, Senpai.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Th-thank you...
I'll use it with care.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I'm glad Claire-senpai seemed happy with it.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Here, Pinon-chan.
It's White Day, so this is my return gift...

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
Hm? Now that you mention it, today is
White Day... Well then, I'll take it
without holding back.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I hope you like it...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah, collecting ribbons is your hobby,
right, Pinon-chan? So I bought a ribbon
I thought would look cute on you.

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
Whoaaa~ It's so cute~
Is it okay? Can I really have this?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Of course.
I'm glad you're that happy about it.

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en: Ah!

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
N-no, I was only overdoing it
to make YOU happy, got it?!

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
Well, I suppose I can at least
say thank you...

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en: Th-thanks... \p.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Pinon-chan seemed happy, so I'm
really glad I gave her a return gift.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It's White Day today, but I wonder
if Saotome-kun remembered?)

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Hey, \p.
Here, this is for the other day...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Hm, thanks for Valentine's, you mean?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Mm, well, something like that.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I see. Thank you, Saotome-kun!
This is, um...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Yeah, it's a 'tenugui,'
the same kind I use all the time.
rows.notes: Alto. Tenugui (thin cotton hand towel) kept, since the player repeats the unfamiliar word next row.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: 'Tenugui'?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Yeah. Unlike a towel, it dries fast and
feels nice on your skin, so I figured
it'd be good for a woman.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Just what I'd expect from a genius
of female roles! You really know women!
rows.notes: Tensai onnagata = kabuki actor of female roles (as slice 334: 'played female roles').

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
If you're gonna tease me,
give that back!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Ah, sorry, sorry!
I'll gratefully accept it!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Saotome-kun's surprisingly considerate.
That alone makes me kind of happy.)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
\p, good timing.
I was just looking for you.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Here's my return gift for Valentine's.
Take it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Thank you, Michel-kun.
...Wait, what is this?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Fashion glasses with no prescription.
I bet they'd look great on you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Wow... Thank you so much, Michel-kun.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Glad you like them.
I picked out something I thought would suit you,
so try them on sometime, okay?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Sure, I'll wear them next time.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(He actually thought about a present for me...
I'm really happy.
Thank you, Michel-kun.)

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
\p-san, good timing!
There's something I wanted to give you.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
This is a return gift for Valentine's.
Please accept it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Thank you, Luca-kun.
...Wait, what is this?

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
It's a vacuum cleaner I built myself.
It's a special model: quiet, yet high-powered!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Wow... Thank you so much, Luca-kun.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
I'm glad you like it!
It was worth building.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, Nanase.
This is a return gift for Valentine's Day,
if you'd like it.

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
\p-kun!
Are you sure? Thank you so much!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I hope you like it...

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
This is... a paintbrush case!
And the pattern's so cute... Thank you!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yeah, go ahead and use it!

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: Yes, I'll start using it right away!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yeah. Let's keep getting along.

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: Yes, likewise!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Looks like Nanase liked it!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Ranka, here's your return gift for White Day.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en:
Wow~ Thank you...!
Ehehe, this is kinda embarrassing...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Go ahead and open it, if you want.

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Huh... This is...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah. I want to keep listening to your songs
forever, Ranka, so I got you throat drops.
They're pretty rare, you know.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Of course.
I bought them for you, Ranka.
rows.notes: Answers Ranka's 'Can I really have this?' (c23263).

rows.speaker: Ranka
rows.en: Th-thank you... \p-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I'm glad Ranka seemed happy with it.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, Sheryl.
This is a return gift for Valentine's Day,
if you'd like it.

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
Oh, \p?
You didn't have to go to all that trouble...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Hm? Sheryl, what's wrong?
rows.notes: Sheryl has spotted the gift and is staring at it.

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Huh... What's that?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
It's Galaxy Candy, from a shop
in Deep Akihabara... It's popular for
its colorful look and poppy design!
rows.notes: Reflowed within 3 lines. Fukashi Akihabara = Deep Akihabara (glossary).

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
Ooh, how cute~!!
...Is that for me?

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:
Thank you~!!
You've got pretty good taste!
I'll be counting on you from now on, too!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Oh, uh, yeah. Same here.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I can't believe Sheryl was that happy...
That made the present totally worth it!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Klan-senpai,
it's White Day, so here's my return gift.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Y-yes, well...
This is strangely embarrassing, isn't it?

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: Th-this is...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
You said your hobby was fashion, Senpai,
so I bought you some clothes I thought
would look good on you.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: Am I truly allowed to have this?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Of course.
I bought them for you, Klan-senpai.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, no need to thank me...
Please keep looking out for me,
Klan-senpai.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: Mm, and I'm counting on you as well!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Klan-senpai seemed happy, so I'm
really glad I gave her a return gift.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(It's already been two weeks
since Sheryl transferred here...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I feel like the restless mood at Mihoshi
has finally settled down quite a bit.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(When she first transferred,
Mihoshi was all Sheryl, all the time...)

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en: Excuse me, do you have a moment?
rows.notes: ??? (woman) = Grace, unnamed until c23349; shared male/female.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Y-yes?

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:

That's it for today's class!
All of you, fall in!

can make any sense of.

Show up for the new term alive and kicking!
That's one order you'd better not break!!

so cheer me on, \p-kun!

rows.speaker: Ranka

I hope you take first place next year.

rows.speaker: Sheryl

rows.speaker: Sheryl

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en:

rows.speaker: Sheryl

There's no fleet-wide funeral, and not even
your own family gets told what really happened...

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
...Report to the barracks as a trainee
by 0800 tomorrow morning.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Understood! Ozma-san!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Player still calls him Ozma-san; he corrects it next row.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: Heh. Starting tomorrow, it's Major Ozma.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Starting tomorrow, I'm gonna drill you
into the ground. Better brace yourself.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Go easy on me, okay, Michel?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Starting tomorrow, I'm part of S.M.S. too...
I'm going to fight to protect Frontier!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Am I really ready to join S.M.S.
and put my life on the line in battle...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Please... Please let me join S.M.S.!!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Go easy on me, okay, Michel-kun?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Starting tomorrow, I'm a member of S.M.S. too...
I'll fight to protect Frontier as well!)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
This is Ozma.
We're holding your final enlistment test, starting now.
rows.notes: Phone call to the player; shared male/female.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
It's an emergency call-up. You don't get to refuse.
Get to the Macross Quarter immediately.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Oh, there you are.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I never expected the final test
to be sprung on me out of nowhere.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Hey, don't get so worked up.
Just do what you always do, and you'll pass.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
That's right. Good luck out there,
\p-san.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yeah, thanks, Luca.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: All right, let's head out.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I'm passing this, no matter what!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
I never expected the final test
to be sprung on me out of nowhere.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Yeah, thank you, Luca-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I'm going to pass this, no matter what!)

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Don't get down, \p.
Your moves weren't half bad.
rows.notes: Klan, after the player loses the mock battle.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Not bad at all,
\p.
rows.notes: Klan, after the player wins the mock battle.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
...Wait, my opponent in the mock battle
was you, Klan-senpai!?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Actually, before that...
you're in S.M.S. too...?
rows.notes: Shozoku shiteta-n desu ne: surprise at learning she belongs to S.M.S.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: Hm? Come to think of it, I never told you, did I?

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
I am Captain Klan Klang,
leader of the S.M.S. Pixie Team.
rows.notes: Pixie shoutai = 'Pixie Team' per glossary; taii = Captain.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Judging by your skills today,
you've got pretty good instincts.
Keep at it, boy.
rows.notes: Male version; Klan calls him shounen ('boy'). Female version c24010 drops it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (So Klan-senpai was in S.M.S. too...)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: We welcome you as an official member of S.M.S.!
rows.notes: Ends Ozma's announcement begun in c20799 ('As of this moment, you...', slice 290, not yet translated). Written as a full sentence so it stands whatever c20799 becomes; the subject 'we' (S.M.S.) is restored.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: You did it, \p.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Congratulations,
\p-san.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Thanks, Michel, Luca.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Not bad, \p.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Thanks to you too, Alto...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: ...Wait, Alto, what are you doing in S.M.S.!?
rows.notes: Japanese names Alto in the third person; he is right there, so addressed directly. Michel answers next.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
This guy officially joined S.M.S.
just the other day, too.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
All right! We're off to Nyan-Nyan to celebrate
you passing! We'll be drinking till dawn,
so get ready!
rows.notes: Ozma; kakugo shite oke = brace yourself.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Captain Ozma, we're still minors, so...
rows.notes: Luca. Ozma-taichou = 'Captain Ozma' per glossary (taichou, decided 2026-10-17); the rank shousa stays 'Major'.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: Tch, that's right...

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: Whatever. Either way, we're partying tonight!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Now I've officially been accepted
as a member of S.M.S.)

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Judging by your skills today,
you've got pretty good instincts.
Keep at it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (So Klan-senpai was in S.M.S. too...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Thank you, Michel-kun, Luca-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Thank you too, Saotome-kun...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
...Wait, Saotome-kun, what are you doing
in S.M.S.!?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Now I've officially been accepted
as a member of S.M.S.)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Hey, \p...
I know you're anxious, but calm down a little.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
We're going to rescue the surviving Galaxy ships.
In the state you're in, you won't even save
the ones who could be saved.
rows.notes: Zanzonkan = the surviving ships (of the Galaxy fleet), as in mission text u2995.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Michel... I know, but......

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The surviving ships that contacted us
are still under attack from the Vajra, too...)
rows.notes: Source closes the bracket with a half-width ')'; plain parentheses either way.

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
We'll be meeting up with the surviving ships shortly.
Pilots, stand by!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh!? Cathy-san?

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
Why, if it isn't \p-kun.
So you joined S.M.S.

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
As of today, I've been assigned
to S.M.S. as an observer.
I look forward to working with you.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Likewise, I look forward to working with you.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
\p!
Save the greetings for after we get back!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: S-sorry! Major Ozma!

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Skull Leader to all units. Listen up,
I'm not letting a single one of you die.
We're all coming home to Frontier alive!

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: All right! Let's move out!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Michel-kun... I know, but......

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
Why, if it isn't \p-san.
So you joined S.M.S.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(We couldn't rescue every one
of the surviving Galaxy ships...)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Seems Alto and the others made it out
of the enemy ship safely, too.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Geez, those guys... Once their injuries heal,
looks like I'll have to retrain them from scratch.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
You did good work out there.
Now, let's head back to Frontier.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Looks like the mission was a success,
but I wasn't much help...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(We couldn't rescue every one
of the surviving Galaxy ships...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Sounds like an order came in from the New U.N.
Forces. I wonder what kind of mission it is?)

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en: Looks like everyone's here.

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en: Then let's begin the mission briefing.

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
This mission is to destroy and investigate
a Vajra nest that's been discovered.

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
To stop the Vajra from multiplying, I want you
to destroy as many Vajra eggs as you can.
rows.notes: Cathy's request (-te choudai) to the pilots.

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
Your mission also includes bringing back
samples for analysis.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
I understand the mission outline.
But a mission inside a Vajra nest means...

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
Yes, there's a good chance the Vajra will show up.
Carry out the demolition and survey carefully.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(So this mission is to destroy and investigate
a Vajra nest...)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Leave the backup to me, Alto.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Yeah, I'm counting on you, 'Michel.'
rows.notes: Alto; the Japanese sets the name off in quotes because he used to insist on 'Michael' (c24050).

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Huh? Alto and Michel seem to be getting
along even better than before...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Hold on!
Alto... you just called him Michel, didn't you!?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
You always stubbornly called him 'Michael'
before...
rows.notes: Shared male/female; player to Alto. Mihaeru = Michael (glossary en Michael Blanc), the formal name Alto used to use.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Wh-who cares about that!?
C'mon, let's hurry up and get ready to sortie!!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Geez, wait up, Alto.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Heh heh. Come on, let's get ready to sortie too,
\p-san.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I really wonder what happened between those two...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(But right now I need to focus on the mission.
Okay, let's do this!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Sounds like an order came in from the New U.N.
Forces. I wonder what kind of mission it is?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(So this mission is to destroy and investigate
a Vajra nest...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Huh? Saotome-kun and Michel-kun seem to be
getting along even better than before...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Hold on!
Saotome-kun... you just called him Michel,
didn't you!?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(But right now I need to focus on the mission.
Okay, let's do this!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Oh, good work to you too,
Cathy-san.
rows.notes: Shared male/female; reply to Cathy's 'otsukaresama' (c24066 / c20863).

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
We may get another request.
I'll be counting on you when we do.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Understood!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Phew... We managed to intercept the Vajra,
but I wasn't much help...)
rows.notes: Subject 'we' restored for the interception (team effort).

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Phew... I'm glad we managed to intercept the Vajra.)

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en: Good work, \p-san.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Michel told me the rebellion on Gallia 4, where
Sheryl and the others were taken hostage, had
been put down safely, so I was relieved, but...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(But after that, all contact was cut off...
What on earth is happening on Gallia 4?)

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
Multiple defold reactions detected
in the space dead ahead of the Frontier fleet!

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
A huge swarm of Vajra has appeared, including
several carrier-class! Pilots, sortie immediately!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Damn it! Why do the Vajra have to show up now,
when Alto and Michel aren't here...!)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
We can't let the Vajra get
any closer to Frontier!
We're sortieing as a mobile strike force!

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: I'll show them... I'll show them I can do it too!
rows.notes: Luca, keyed up (boku datte yatte yaru).

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Luca seems awfully wound up about something.
Is he going to be okay?)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: All right! We're heading out too!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(We can't let the Vajra get
any closer to Frontier!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Michel-kun told me the rebellion on Gallia 4,
where Sheryl and the others were taken hostage,
had been put down safely, so I was relieved, but...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(But after that, all contact was cut off...
What on earth is happening on Gallia 4?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Why do the Vajra have to show up now, when
Saotome-kun and Michel-kun aren't here...!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Luca-kun seems awfully wound up about something.
I wonder if he'll be okay...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(We can't let the Vajra get
any closer to Frontier!)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Looks like Ranka was rescued safely
from the Vajra ship, too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: So she's safe. Thank goodness...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh? Captain Klan,
what's the big hurry?
rows.notes: Shared male/female; Kuran taii = Captain Klan.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: I-I'm not in any hurry!

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
I just heard Michel got hurt, so I was thinking
I'd go visit him, that's all...

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
S-sorry, but I'll be taking my leave now.
It's not like I'm dying to see that Michel's okay
or anything! Don't get the wrong idea!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yes, yes, I get it.
Just hurry up and go visit Michel.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I should go visit Michel too...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(We managed to protect Frontier from the Vajra,
but I wasn't much help...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yes, yes, I get it.
Just hurry up and go visit Michel-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I should go visit Michel-kun too...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Well, I'm off duty today.
Maybe I'll go out somewhere...)

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en: Got a minute, \p-kun?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Huh? Oh, sure.
What is it, Cathy-san?

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
It's an order for a top-secret mission.
Listen with that in mind.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: A top-secret mission?

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en:
Yes. You'll get the details at the briefing, but
apparently it's escort duty for an experiment
using Ranka-san's singing...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Escorting Ranka...?

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: This mission is escort duty for Ranka.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
What do you mean, an experiment using
Ranka's singing, Major Ozma?

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
The brass seem to think that letting the Vajra hear
Ranka's singing will have some kind of effect.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: A Minmay Attack on the Vajra...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Damn it, sending Ranka onto the battlefield
for something nobody can even prove...!

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
There's only one thing we can do!
Don't let those Vajra lay a single finger on Ranka!!

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: Let's go!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Making the Vajra listen to a song... What on earth
is the Frontier government thinking?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I have to protect Ranka, no matter what!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Well, I'm off duty today.
Maybe I'll go out somewhere...)

rows.speaker: Cathy
rows.en: Got a minute, \p-san?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Escorting Ranka-chan...?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
What do you mean, an experiment using
Ranka-chan's singing, Major Ozma?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Making the Vajra listen to a song... What on earth
is the Frontier government thinking?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I have to protect Ranka-chan, no matter what!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I wasn't much use
as Ranka's escort...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Phew... Somehow I managed to do my job
as Ranka's escort.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Still, I was surprised...
Who'd have thought Ranka's singing
would actually work on the Vajra...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Maybe this'll make the fighting ahead
a little easier...)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Damn it!
Ranka's singing, used as a tool of war...!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Major Ozma...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Ranka doesn't sing
for the sake of fighting...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Yeah...
I have to keep protecting Ranka, no matter what!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I wasn't much use
as Ranka-chan's escort...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Phew... Somehow I managed to do my job
as Ranka-chan's escort.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Still, I was surprised...
Who'd have thought Ranka-chan's singing
would actually work on the Vajra...)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Argh!
Ranka's singing, used as a tool of war...!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Ranka-chan doesn't sing
for the sake of fighting...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Yeah...
I have to keep protecting Ranka-chan,
no matter what!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Major Ozma was wounded in the last battle...
If we keep on fighting the Vajra like this,
we're bound to...)
rows.notes: Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Who'd have thought the Vajra would show up
right before the super-long-distance fold...
rows.notes: Michel. Choukyori fold = 'super-long-distance fold' as in mission text u3011.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Why now, of all times...
My plan is ruined!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Griping about it here won't get us anywhere.
We're heading out!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Major Ozma was wounded in the last battle...
If we keep on fighting the Vajra like this,
we're bound to...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Damn it! There's no point staying here!
I need to get to the S.M.S. base and grab
a weapon!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Somehow I made it to the hangar...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(But the Vajra are still running wild in the city.
I need to sortie, fast!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Why are there Vajra inside the ship!? Weren't
we supposed to have escaped them with the
super-long-distance fold!?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Ugh! There's no point staying here!
I need to get to the S.M.S. base and grab
a weapon!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Somehow I made it to the hangar...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(But the Vajra are still running wild in the city.
I need to sortie, fast!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The Vajra nearly got me,
but it looks like I somehow survived...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Looks like we somehow managed
to wipe out the Vajra...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Alto! And Luca, you're safe too!

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Yes. I'm so glad you're safe too,
\p-san...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Just barely...
But how did the Vajra get inside the ship?

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: They might have been breeding inside the Island...

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Because of those Vajra, Michel...!
rows.notes: Alto; trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Michel? What happened to Michel!?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Don't tell me......

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: He was trying to protect Klan...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: No... That can't be true......

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Michel... no......
How... how could this happen...!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The Vajra nearly got me,
but it looks like I somehow survived...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Looks like we somehow managed
to wipe out the Vajra...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Saotome-kun! And Luca-kun, you're safe too!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Michel-kun? What happened to Michel-kun!?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: No... That can't be true......

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Michel-kun... no......
How... how could this happen...!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(The ship's in ruins, and the ecosystem can't be
sustained anymore... In a situation like this...
what are we supposed to do...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(An order from our owner, Mr. Bilrer, to dissolve
S.M.S. and fold it into the New U.N. Forces...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Birura-shi: glossary 'Richard Bilrer' is status needs_check (wiki says Birler); 'Mr.' for -shi.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Captain Jeffrey and the others didn't trust such
a sudden order, so I deserted Frontier with them
to find out the truth, but...)
rows.notes: The distrust belongs to Jeffrey and co. (modifier on Jeffrey-kanchou-tachi); the player deserted with them.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I never imagined a truth like this
was waiting for us......)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
So you're saying Grace is using fold quartz
and the Vajra to bring all of humanity
under her control.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: Yeah, that's the size of it.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Even the Vajra, who we thought were behind
it all, were just being used by Grace...)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Ruling the galaxy...
I figured it was some kind of joke,
but it looks like they're dead serious.

rows.speaker: Canaria
rows.en:
And the key to it all is the one
human who has a way to communicate
with the Vajra...

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: Ranka......

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Right now, they're heading for the planet where
the Queen, the heart of the Vajra, resides.
rows.notes: Joou = Queen (Vajra Queen in mission text).

rows.speaker: Bobby
rows.en:
Which means we can't just let them
have things their way, hmm?

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: Exactly!

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
We're heading to the Vajra planet too,
and we're going to crush Grace's ambitions!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Controlling people's minds
to take the galaxy for herself...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I'm not letting Grace have her way!
I'm going to rescue Ranka, no matter what!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I won't let Grace have her way!
I'm going to rescue Ranka-chan, no matter what!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Oh, that's right. Isn't Hilda-sensei holding
a special extra lesson later today?)
rows.notes: Trial course start. Hoshuu = 'Extra Lesson' (event title u0163).

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Today's extra lesson covers

But without the basics, there's no applying them!
Mastering what you learned today is the surest
shortcut to getting better.

(I'd better review this properly later
so I don't forget what I learned today.)

since I started at Mihoshi Academy High School.)

Alto Saotome

I was just thinking it's really been over
a year since I started at Mihoshi.

Now that you mention it...
It's already been a year since I switched
to the Pilot Course, huh...

Whoa, whoa.
Why are you getting all nostalgic too, Alto?

Michael Blanc
An honor student with the top grades in the Pilot
Course. Loves teasing Alto until he blows up.

Well, it really has gone by fast, though.
I remember starting at Mihoshi

Luca Angeloni

Skipped grades and is a whiz with computers.

There were so many fun events, like the Culture
Fest, that the time just flew by, didn't it?

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
I go to a different school from all of you...
I wish I'd gone to Mihoshi with everyone~

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Ranka Lee
A girl who loves to sing and dreams of becoming
a singer. A huge fan of top idol Sheryl.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)

Going to a different school doesn't matter,
Ranka-san! Just having tea with you like this

rows.speaker: Commentary

Nanase Matsuura
A classmate in the Mihoshi Academy Art Course.
Adores Ranka and works with her at Nyan-Nyan.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Th-that's right!
For me too, having tea with Michel and everyone...

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Klan Klang
Has a 'clumsy gene' that makes her childlike when
micronized. Michel's childhood friend.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
...Personally, I'd rather be enjoying tea
with some more beautiful older ladies.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Grr... Michel!
You two-timing cad! Stay right there!!

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Heh heh. Those two
are the same as ever.

rows.speaker: Alto

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Seems to me Alto and Michel are always
doing the same kind of thing, though.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: Ranka

Hee hee.
I hope we can all have fun together

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

(Today was the first class of the new year,
so I'm glad it was just orientation.)

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Hilda V. Bergen
Mihoshi Academy High teacher in charge of
'Basic Training.' A cool beauty, strict with students.
rows.notes: Class names as in the campus help text (u5460 basic training, u5459 practical training).

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
From the next class on, I'll be as strict as ever!
Brace yourselves!

rows.speaker: ??? (man)
rows.en:
Harsh as ever, isn't she...
Well, hang in there, you guys.

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Gary Murdoch
Mihoshi Academy High teacher in charge of
'Practical Training.' A big brother to his students.

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: And what are you doing, coming to watch my class?

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
I don't have a class this period.
I was bored, so I came by to watch.

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
Bored... you say......?
I believe I asked you to set up the equipment
we're using in the next class?

rows.speaker: Gary
rows.en:
......Oh, I just remembered I've got something to do.
See ya!

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en:
Get back here, Gary!
Why, you...!!

rows.en:
(Gary-sensei's getting chewed out
by Hilda-sensei again...)

rows.speaker: ??? (man)
rows.en: Haha, Gary-sensei never changes, huh.

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Yuuto Kagura
A classmate in the Mihoshi Academy Pilot Course.
Loves to train.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
But it kind of looks like they're both
enjoying it, don't you think...

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Miyuki Shirakawa
Pilot Course classmate at Mihoshi Academy. An elite
from a military family, and Kagura's childhood friend.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm. One of those shady
grown-up affairs, I'd wager.
rows.notes: ??? (woman) = Hoshimura (her caption follows); old-man diction (-desu naa) per glossary.

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Yui Hoshimura
A classmate in the Mihoshi Academy Pilot Course.
An energetic girl who loves tinkering with machines.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Hoshimura...
Don't you ever say that in front of Hilda-sensei.
Not even nine lives would be enough...
rows.notes: Inochi ga ikutsu atte mo tarinai.

rows.speaker: ??? (man)
rows.en: Heh. Truth is, those two, back in the day...

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Luis Fernando
A mysterious figure who often shows up at Mihoshi
Academy. A hot-blooded man overflowing with passion.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Y-you sure showed up out of nowhere...
Luis-san...

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
I can't quite explain it, but my passion told me
I'd better make an appearance right about now.

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en:
So? So? What happened in Hilda-sensei and
Gary-sensei's past? Tell me, Luis-cchi~
rows.notes: Luisu-cchi: Hoshimura's cutesy nickname suffix, kept in romaji like the honorifics; not in the honorific table.

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
Heh, if you're gonna beg like that, I can't refuse.
It happened some years back, on Gallia 4...

rows.speaker: Kagura
rows.en:
\p, Hoshimura,
we'd better head back to the classroom
or we'll be late for the next class.

rows.speaker: Hoshimura
rows.en:
Awww!
And just when the story was getting good~!!

rows.speaker: Shirakawa
rows.en:
Yui, don't be difficult.
Come on, let's hurry back to class.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Well, Luis-san, sorry to leave in the middle
of your story, but we have to go.

rows.speaker: Luis
rows.en:
Heh, hit the books hard,
boys & girls!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Okay, I'd better hurry back to the classroom
and get ready for the next class...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Still, Luis-san...

and Gary-sensei's past?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

Heh, hit the books hard,
boy & girls!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Now I'm curious...)

rows.en:

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Itsuki Yamashiro
Mihoshi Academy teacher in charge of "Lectures"
Serious by nature; his talks can run a bit long...
rows.notes: Character card. Name given-name first per glossary. Zagaku class = "Lectures", as the schedule help (u5458 'Attend lectures'). Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: What is it, Yamashiro-sensei?

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
I noticed something while grading the last quiz.
You can handle the basic questions, but your
accuracy drops sharply on the applied ones.

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
And that, of course, is because you haven't
properly grasped the fundamentals...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I know he's warning me for my own good, but
it looks like Yamashiro-sensei's talk is gonna
run long...)

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Hehe, you haven't changed a bit,
Yamashiro-sensei...
rows.notes: Claire, before her name card. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
But if you go on that long,
even \p-kun is going to
get sick of it.

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Claire Stanford
A Mihoshi Academy graduate
A dependable upperclassman who looks after others
rows.notes: Character card; senpai as a common noun translated. Shared M/F.

What brings you to Mihoshi?

rows.speaker: Claire

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)

Yuu Akimizu

Adores Claire, who's helped her out in many ways

rows.en:
Claire-senpai...
I'm sooo happy to see you after so long!

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Funny, I'm pretty sure I saw you on our day off
last week, Yuu?

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en: H-huh? Did you...?

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en:
Hey, you lot.
Crowding around here gets in the other
students' way.
rows.notes: Pinon, before her name card. Shared M/F.

Pinon Colette
A child prodigy who skipped ahead into Mihoshi
She also teaches the "Special Lectures" class

rows.en: Honestly, you people...

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Long time no see, Pinon-chan.
Hehe, still as tiny and cute as ever~

rows.speaker: Pinon

Hey! Don't call me tiny!

rows.speaker: Akimizu
rows.en:
I know, right?
Pinon-chan's still as tiny and cute as ever!

I said call me S-e-n-s-e-i!
And stop saying I'm still tiny!!
I've grown a little too, you know!!!

rows.speaker: Yamashiro
rows.en:
Sorry, but I'm bringing us back on topic.
As I was saying, you need to get a firm grip
on the basics...

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en:
\p, help me~!
It's Claire! Claire's got me~!!
rows.notes: Japanese is just 'Claire is--! Claire is~!!'; 'got me' made explicit (Claire is hugging her, next row). Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Claire
rows.en:
Ufufufu...
Hugging Pinon-chan still feels as amazing
as ever...

rows.speaker: Pinon
rows.en: GYAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(This doesn't look like it's wrapping up anytime
soon... Would it be okay if I just went home...?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Still, honestly...
Everyone around me is so lively and fun.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Well, class is over.
Maybe I'll head home soon.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I know he's warning me for my own good, but

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

(Still, honestly...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I came by S.M.S. since I was bored, but...)

rows.speaker: ??? (man)
rows.en: Goddammit!
rows.notes: Ozma, before his name card. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Ozma Lee
Leader of S.M.S.'s Skull Squadron
Ranka's adoptive brother, with a huge sister complex

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Captain Ozma's so on edge...
What on earth happened to him?
rows.notes: Spoken aloud (Bobby answers). Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.speaker: ??? (man)
rows.en:
Seems Ranka-chan wants to go to
Sheryl's concert.
rows.notes: Bobby, before his name card. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Bobby Margot
Helmsman of the Macross Quarter
A man with the heart of a maiden

rows.speaker: Bobby
rows.en:
But it's Sheryl's concert, of all things!
Tickets are so hard to get, poor Ozma's
in a real pickle.

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en: Ozma spoils Ranka rotten, as always.
rows.notes: Canaria, before her name card. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Canaria Berstein
A pilot with S.M.S.
Works as a medic when not in combat

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Well, that's nothing new.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Dammit! I can't even get Ranka
one lousy ticket...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Don't get so down, Captain Ozma.
I'm sure you'll get your hands on a ticket.
rows.notes: Shared M/F. Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Come to think of it, I hear you're doing
stunts at Sheryl's concert.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Then getting one ticket should be a piece of
cake for you, right?

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
That's an order from your commander!
Get me a ticket to Sheryl's concert, no matter what!
rows.notes: Taichou meirei = an order from the squad leader. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
And if you can't get one...
you know what'll happen, right?

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Y-yes sir!!

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en: Good! I'm counting on you, then.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Captain Ozma... I know it's for Ranka, but
he doesn't have to make it an order...)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I mean, this is just a flat-out threat...)

rows.speaker: ??? (woman)
rows.en: Sounds rough, \p.
rows.notes: Klan, before her name card. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Klan Klang
Klan Klang, macronized to Zentradi size
Leader of S.M.S.'s Pixie Team
rows.notes: Character card. Zentradi-ka = macronized. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en: Ozma's doting on Ranka is a real headache too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Tell me about it...

rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Heh, well, it's for Ranka's sake too.
Do your best to get her that ticket, boy.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: I'll do the best I can...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(If I can't get that ticket,
Captain Ozma might actually kill me...)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Haah... I'd better give it my all...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Captain Ozma's so on edge...
I wonder what on earth happened?
rows.notes: Female version of c24311. Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Captain Ozma...
I know it's for Ranka-chan, but
he doesn't have to make it an order...)
