rows.speaker: Klan
rows.en:
Heh, well, it's for Ranka's sake too.
Do your best to get her that ticket.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(If I can't get that ticket,
Captain Ozma might kill me...)
rows.notes: Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Today's the day of Sheryl's concert
I've been waiting for.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Just thinking I'll meet the Galactic Fairy
makes me nervous. I've gotta be careful
not to mess up during the real show...)

rows.speaker: Sheryl
rows.en: Listen to my song~~!!!
rows.notes: Sheryl's signature line, full force. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Commentary
rows.en:
Sheryl Nome
A top idol known as the "Galactic Fairy"
Visiting the Frontier fleet on her galactic tour

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Amazing...!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: The Galactic Fairy......

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (So this is the Galactic Fairy's performance...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I get to see something this amazing up close...
I'm really glad I got to be part of
Sheryl's concert...)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Whoa, can't stand around gawking forever.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Hey, \p.
We're on soon.
Don't just stand there spacing out.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Y-yeah... I know, Michel.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Then let's go!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(All right! I'll show them acrobatics that
can hold their own against Sheryl's song!!)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Geez, that Alto, pulling something
that reckless...

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
But that sure was a shock, wasn't it?
Sheryl suddenly doing something that
wasn't in the program.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah, really.
Those of us covering for Alto were pretty
rattled too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I guess she's free-spirited, just like you'd
expect from someone called the Galactic Fairy......)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Huh?! An evacuation alert?!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Let's go, Luca, \p.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: What on earth is going on, Michel?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Apparently the Frontier fleet is under attack
by unidentified creatures that appeared
out of nowhere.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Looks like the U.N. Government has also
issued a sortie request to S.M.S.
rows.notes: Tougou seifu: per the brief tougou = U.N.; glossary has only chikyuu tougou seifu 'U.N. Government' / shin tougou seifu 'New U.N. Government'. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Our orders are to get back to S.M.S. right away
and sortie immediately.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Looks like this is going to be
your first real combat.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

Not the simulator, a real battle...!)

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: You ready to sortie, \p?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Hey! Are you listening?!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Ah! Y-yeah... Sorry, Michel.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
This isn't training!
You'll get yourself killed like that!!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

If I get shot down, what's waiting for me is...)

rows.en: There's only one thing I can tell you.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: ......Don't die.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: ...Right!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: All right! We're heading out too!!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I'm coming back alive, no matter what!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

I've been waiting for.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Just thinking I'll meet the Galactic Fairy
makes me nervous. I've gotta be careful
not to mess up during the real show...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Y-yeah... I know, Michel-kun.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(All right! I'll show them acrobatics that
can hold their own against Sheryl's song!!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Yeah, really.
Those of us covering for Saotome-kun were
pretty rattled too.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

in one piece.)

rows.en:

Alto'll be fine.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(There haven't been any Vajra attacks since then...
I hope things stay quiet like this......)

rows.speaker: Operator
rows.en:
Emergency notice.
Distress call received from the Galaxy fleet.
Commencing rescue operation. Repeat...

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (A distress call from the Galaxy fleet?!)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
The Vajra have attacked the Galaxy fleet,
and it's now in critical danger.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (No way... the Galaxy fleet......)

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
This mission, on Sheryl's order, is to rescue
the Galaxy fleet's evacuee ships.
rows.notes: Sheryl no oodaa: she ordered (commissioned) the mission. Shared M/F.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Mission code: "Galactic Fairy"!
Let's go!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Still, what a surprise.

S.M.S....)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

Galaxy refugee ships and attack the
Frontier fleet...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

we somehow managed to protect it...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

rows.en:

were so sharp. Seriously amazing.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Alto, that acrobatic move you pulled in class
today came off really clean.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Heh, I was just in good form today.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Really...
rows.notes: Michel, leading into the next row.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: You're not half bad, Princess.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Michael......!
How many times have I told you not to call me
Princess...
rows.notes: Alto uses the full name Mihaeru: 'Michael' per glossary en (Michael Blanc).

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Don't get so worked up.
You'll ruin that pretty face of yours.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Knock it off!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Whoops, guess I took the joke a little too far.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: What were you even trying to do, Michel?

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Well, you see,
he wanted to compliment Alto-senpai, but he
was too embarrassed to just say it straight.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Right, Michel-senpai?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: No comment.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

He should just compliment him straight out...)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Hmm,
I forgot until I took my first class of the year,
but it's already a new year: 2059, huh.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Last year was so hectic, with me joining S.M.S.
and all, it doesn't even feel like the year
changed.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Well, then again, a lot happened,
so I guess it was a pretty full year.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (I wonder what kind of year this one'll be.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(A sudden meeting? That's unusual.
Did something happen?)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
All right, everyone's here.
Let's start the emergency meeting.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
We've received a request to perform EX-Gear
acrobatics at a certain singer's
concert.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Whether we accept this request or not
is today's topic.
Let me hear what you all think.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Hmm... let's see......)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
Wait, huh?
Whose concert is it, anyway?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Whoops, I forgot to explain that.
I don't know if you guys have heard of her,
but......

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: It's a concert by someone called Sheryl Nome.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Word is, people call her the Galactic Fairy
or something.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
H-hey,
...S...seriously,
it's Sheryl's concert?

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Yeah, seriously.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.notes: Michel here; also the player in scd_tst_005.

rows.speaker: Pilot Students
rows.en: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Heh, you guys reacted even better than I
expected. Couldn't be happier.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
I don't think I even need to ask,
but we're doing the show, right?

rows.speaker: Pilot Students
rows.en: No proble~~~~~~m!!!!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Geez, you guys are so easy to read.
Makes my job a lot easier.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Hehe, they sure are.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
And what about Alto-kun over there with the
sour face? Not happy about doing the concert?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: ......Not really.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Getting that mad will ruin your cute little
face, Prin-cess Alto.
rows.notes: Hi-me spelled out with a dot for emphasis; rendered 'Prin-cess'.

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en:
Grr!
Mi~cha~el~~!!
rows.notes: Name drawn out syllable by syllable (Mihaeru = Michael).

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Geez, you two are always fighting.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Will the concert be okay with things like this?

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
It'll be fine.
If nothing else, everyone's skills are the
real deal.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: Guess that's true.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Sheryl Nome......
I get to meet the Galactic Fairy.)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(I should at least get ready to ask for
her autograph...)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Oh, today's Valentine's Day.
If I don't get chocolate from anybody,
I'll be pretty bummed...)
rows.notes: Japanese indents the second line inside the brackets with a full-width space; indent dropped.

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: So this is where you all were, \p-kun.
rows.notes: \p-kun tachi = the player and the others.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
What's up, Nanase?
You need something from us?

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
Since today's Valentine's Day,
I brought chocolate for everyone, but......

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
It's homemade, so I'm sorry if it's not
to your taste.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en:
Y-you made it yourself, Nanase-san?!
Then it's definitely going to be delicious!

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en: Thank you, Luca-kun.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Nanase-san......

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
Okay, next I'll give Ranka-san my true-love
cho...!
rows.notes: Honmei choco, cut off mid-word as in the Japanese.

rows.speaker: Nanase
rows.en:
......I mean,
I have to go give her some friend chocolate,
so if you'll excuse me.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
Lucky you, Luca.
Nanase gave you some 'ob-li-ga-tion' chocolate.
rows.notes: Gi-ri choco spelled out for emphasis: obligation chocolate.

rows.speaker: Luca
rows.en: Haah~ Nanase-san's homemade chocolate......

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Good grief......

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
So, Princess, aren't you gonna give me
any chocolate?

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: Like hell I would!

rows.speaker: Pilot Student A
rows.en: Aww~ Alto, you're not giving us any chocolate?

rows.speaker: Pilot Student B
rows.en:

from Alto......

rows.speaker: Alto
rows.en: You guys......!!

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: Ahahahahaha!

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:
(Phew, well, I guess I'm lucky I got any
at all?)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

I've been waiting for.)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

my all!)

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en: (Or so I psyched myself up, but......)

rows.en:

Space out and you'll get yourself killed!!

rows.en: There's only one thing I can tell you......

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en: ......Don't die.

rows.speaker: Michel
rows.en:
All right!
Luca, \p, we're heading out!!

rows.en: Just making it back alive is good enough.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
But you'd better look forward to the special
training coming your way.
rows.notes: Ozma's threat of hard training, said with irony.

rows.speaker: Ozma
rows.en:
Not bad for your first real combat.
Keep it up.

rows.speaker: PLAYER/none
rows.en:

I actually made it back alive......)
